2,Python,What is a Python list?,"A list is an ordered, mutable collection of elements.","A **Python list** is one of the most fundamental and versatile data structures in the Python language. It is an ordered, mutable collection of items that can hold elements of any type (integers, strings, other lists, objects, etc.). Because of its flexibility, lists are used for everything from simple data storage to complex algorithmic work.

column3: Elements keep the order in which they were added. Indexing starts at 0.
You can change, add, or remove elements after the list is created.
The list automatically resizes as you add or remove items.
A single list can contain items of different types.
You can access elements by index or slice a range of elements.
You can loop over a list with `for`, `while`, comprehensions, etc.
